biology.movement-prac-plan.0002.all: Plan: IV cube size/SA:V (at least 5); DV time to colourless; control acid conc/volume, temperature, agar/indicator; repeats + means; same source of agar

biology.movement-prac-risk.0002.b: use white background to judge end point / same person judges / use stopwatch

biology.nervous-data-graph.0002.a: as light intensity increases pupil diameter decreases; decrease slows/levels off at high intensity; quote values
biology.nervous-data-graph.0002.b: receptors in retina detect light; reflex via brain; circular muscles of iris contract, radial muscles relax; pupil constricts

biology.nervous-data-pct.0002.b: retina detects light intensity; impulses to brain; reflex: circular muscles of iris contract, radial relax, pupil smaller

biology.nervous-data-plot.0003.b: reaction time decreases with trial number, rapidly at first then levels off at about 240 ms

biology.nervous-describe.0005.all: nervous uses electrical impulses, hormonal chemicals in blood; nervous faster; nervous short-lasting, hormonal longer; nervous targeted, hormonal widespread

biology.nervous-describe-multi.0007.b: light refracted by cornea; further refracted/focused by lens; inverted image on retina; lens shape adjusted by ciliary muscles

biology.nervous-explain.0006.all: optic nerve carries impulses from retina to brain; if damaged impulses cannot reach brain so no image interpreted

biology.nervous-explain-multi.0007.b: reflex to protect retina from damage by bright light; circular muscles contract, radial relax
